claim: A station observation needs station, pollutant, timestamp and source provenance.
A well-fitted particulate respirator does not filter every gas and does not replace emission controls.
Portable cleaner effectiveness depends on room size, airflow and maintenance.
Pergub DKI 66/2020 is recorded as effective on 24 December 2020.
Permen LHK 8/2023 covers categories M, N, O and L older than three years.
A program statement does not establish a complete inspection or sanction denominator.
Source-apportionment estimates require local methods, periods and limitations and should not be treated as a universal causal ranking.
A court record can establish a direction or finding but not prove implementation completion.
WHO 2021 recommends 5 micrograms per cubic metre as the annual PM2.5 guideline level.
CEMS connectivity is not by itself proof of emission-limit compliance.
Policy options should distinguish an emissions-reduction intervention from a personal-protection measure.
